mural — 壁画
When the Riverside Community Centre reopened after renovation, staff found that the large mural in the main hall had been painted over.

renovation — 翻新，整修
When the Riverside Community Centre reopened after renovation, staff found that the large mural in the main hall had been painted over.

deliberate — 故意的，蓄意的
The second explanation was a deliberate decision.

minutes — 会议记录
However, Lena checked the minutes of the management meetings.

vandalism — 故意破坏公物
The third explanation was vandalism.

contradicted — 与……矛盾，反驳
The deliberate explanation explained the donation, but the minutes contradicted it.

witness — 目击者
But I didn’t paint the mural.’ The committee could not prove that Tom had painted the mural, but they now had a witness who placed him in the hall.

proven — 被证明的
They concluded that the accidental explanation was the most likely, but they did not say it was proven.
